Interface InputEventVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConnectingScreen, DisconnectedScreen, EndGameScreen, ExitScreen, GameScreen, HomeScreen, LobbyScreen, LoginScreen, TotemPickingScreen, TUIScreen
public interface InputEventVisitor
Visitor interface for dispatching TUI keyboard input events to the current screen without instanceof checks. Implemented by TUIScreen with default no-op handlers; concrete screens override only what they need.
